Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The urine findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant pyuria, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and growth of >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli. Hematuria and proteinuria are mild. The low specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. No casts are seen, suggesting no upper tract involvement. Clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy are recommended.
